name: transforming acidic coiled-coil containing protein 3

function.text: TACC3 encodes transforming acidic coiled-coil-containing protein 3. It participates in neurogenesis and chromosome segregation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
